Other worlds play by different rules.

- §6Water§r needs atmospheric pressure. Without enough air, a water bucket just evaporates. Build a sealed, pressurized room if you need liquid water.
- §6Gravity§r differs on every body: you jump much higher on the Mun than on Earth.
- §6Days§r have their own length. Beds still work and skip to that world's morning.
- §6Nether portals§r do not work away from Earth.
- §cCorrosive§r atmospheres like Eve's eat through your armor first, then through you.
- Gases you vent or leak go into the planet's §6atmosphere§r and can slowly change it.

Breathable air needs at least §e0.21 atm§r of Earth air or §e0.09 atm§r of pure oxygen.

Planets have their own oceans: Minmus has milk, Eve mercury, Ike alkyl bromide and Tekto carbon tetrachloride. Pumps collect them like water. Icy bodies have bedrock deposits of packed ice that a bedrock drill can mine for water.
